import array,json,os,select,subprocess,sys,time
sinks=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['pactl','-f','json','list','sink-inputs'],text=True))
items=[]
for x in sinks:
 p=x.get('properties') or {}; app=str(p.get('application.name') or '').lower(); b=str(p.get('application.process.binary') or '').lower(); m=str(p.get('media.name') or '')
 if (app=='firefox' or b=='firefox') and 'chatgpt' in m.lower(): items.append((int(x.get('index',-1)),m,bool(x.get('corked'))))
print('CONTEXT=text_only_idle_energy_probe')
for idx,media,corked in items:
 cmd=['parec',f'--monitor-stream={idx}','--raw','--format=s16le','--rate=8000','--channels=1']
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 data=bytearray(); deadline=time.monotonic()+0.30; target=8000*2//5
 try:
  while len(data)<target and time.monotonic()<deadline:
   r,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],max(0.0,deadline-time.monotonic()))
   if not r: break
   chunk=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),target-len(data))
   if not chunk: break
   data.extend(chunk)
 finally:
  p.terminate()
  try:p.wait(timeout=0.2)
  except Exception:p.kill()
 a=array.array('h'); a.frombytes(bytes(data[:len(data)//2*2]))
 if sys.byteorder!='little': a.byteswap()
 n=len(a); peak=max((abs(v) for v in a),default=0); rms=(sum(v*v for v in a)/n)**0.5 if n else None
 print(json.dumps({'index':idx,'media':media,'corked':corked,'samples':n,'peak':peak,'rms':rms},separators=(',',':')))
